public_rationale: The reported pilot milestone supports the approximately $8.3 million monthly run-rate conversion, and contemporaneous reporting corroborates the much larger annual ambition. Support depends on reading the monthly figure as a conversion of the explicitly annualized amount. It does not establish actual monthly receipts or failure to meet the full-year target. The sentence is imprecise about duration: the milestone came within six weeks. The exposure percentage also described daily ad exposure in the US pilot, not cumulative participation across all users.
limitations: Supported for the reported financial scale and arithmetic, with the stated timing and audience qualifications.
The milestone was more than $100 million, not an exact ceiling.
The annual target remained a target; this observation does not adjudicate its eventual achievement.

criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous reporting places the pilot near a $100 million annualized revenue scale, equivalent to approximately $8.3 million per month, and reports an annual 2026 advertising ambition in the low billions.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable reporting establishes a materially different pilot run rate or shows that the alleged annual target was misreported. Actual monthly receipts cannot be inferred solely from an annualized figure.
